The Issue of the Illusion Discs

“Henry, after this incident, got consumed by grief, trying to evade the reality of the death of his daughter, henry creates different animatronics that resemble charlie in different stages of her life, using the illusion discs…”

In FNAF, the Illusion discs are small discs inside of some animatronics that alter people’s senses into perceiving the animatronics differently than how they are. The reason I mention this is that these illusion discs could be, and likely would be, altering our perception as to how the robot is actually operating (When I say “our”, I am referring to the POV we’re perceiving the robot from within the stories, not the literal reader itself. This seems obvious, but if a response doc is made, I’d rather not have my words twisted). Using this information, we can completely deem any of these actions the robot is performing to be a result of the Illusion Discs, and thus invalid to scale to Emily, as they wouldn’t even actually be happening.
